summary_notes: CRM notes: Veraflux builds real-time agent assist for high-volume telco support orgs. Primary goals: 1) streaming suggestion feed to agents (typeahead + full-sentences) 2) accurate ticket summarization for follow-up 3) tool-calling (create ticket, fetch order, patch account) with strict guardrails. Stated SLO: P50 <30ms suggestion time, P95 <300ms end-to-end for streaming suggestion tokens during spikes. Wants predictable unit economics — interested in Optimize recommendations and quantization guidance. Security is a hard stop: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs retained for 24 months, KMS integration, and optional on-prem control plane. 'We cannot accept model weights leaving our VPC during PII processing' — paraphrase from CTO.
